title: Holter monitor
what: A small device on your belt records your ECG for a full day, sometimes 2 to 3 days, while you go about your normal life.
why: For skipped beats, racing heart episodes, or fainting, to catch what a short ECG cannot see.
duration: 10 to 15 minutes to fit; usually worn for 24 hours

prepare.title: Shower
prepare.text: Shower beforehand. You usually cannot wash while wearing the device.

prepare.title: Skin
prepare.text: No lotion on your chest. Men may have small areas shaved for the pads.

prepare.title: Clothes
prepare.text: Loose cotton clothes, so the device and wires do not get in the way.

steps: 3 to 7 sticky pads are put on your chest, and the wires connect to the device
The device is clipped to your belt or hung around your neck
For a day, you live as usual: work, walk, take the stairs
Write in a diary what you did, when you felt unwell, and when you took medicine
After a day, the device is removed at the clinic
feel: The device can bother you a bit in bed. You get used to it quickly
after: The report usually takes 1 to 3 days
Glue marks wash off with soap and water
red_flags: Fainting or severe chest pain: call emergency services, even while wearing the device

faq.q: Can I shower with a Holter monitor?
faq.a: Usually not. The device and pads must stay dry. Shower before it is fitted.
The doctor will match the recording to what you did and how you felt. Without a diary, the reading is less useful.

reminders.text: Your Holter monitor is fitted soon. Shower now. You will not be able to wash for a day.
